title: scene-00: per-user filtering breaks /changes
description: Visibility filtering (draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:2342), blocked-contact filtering (:2427), and moderation deferral (:2441) give different users different views, but each account has one state string per type. Nothing says what /changes or /queryChanges report when an object enters or leaves a user's view. Also :2427 and :2441 call queryChanges a 'notification'.
